policy.unit: exact PTDE material identity + shader family + receiver scope
policy.disable_dsr_subsurface_only_when: classification == NO_SUBSURFACE && evidence_level >= HIGH_CONFIDENCE && exact route identity matches

source_evidence.role: DSR MTD/shader + PTDE PHN source corpus
exact MTD -> SPX -> stable receiver census

records.basis: Canonical slot-for-slot body route maps DSR ColDifSpcBmpSubsurf to PTDE plain ColDifSpcBmp. Exact three DSR Subsurf -> ordinary receiver pairs are ABI-certified separately.
records.authorized_effect: May set ptde_subsurface_usage_verified=true and ptde_uses_subsurface=false only after exact material/donor/receiver/draw-path gates pass.

coverage.note: This first source-complete census intentionally records only routes supported by current canonical evidence. It does not infer absence of Subsurface from material names or missing DSR-only variants.
